_note: Lab Rizon 4s + GN01 cell. Values marked VERIFY come from flexiv_control (rizon4s_actahead_lab.yaml, safety/actahead_lab.yaml), aioflexiv defaults or newton_handoff_20260921 and must be checked on the real cell at low speed before the first session. The robot serial number is never stored here; pass it with --robot-sn or ROBOT_SN.

model._frames: The model world frame is used as the robot frame. API coordinates are model coordinates shifted so the table top is z = 0.

robot._q_home: VERIFY: lab home posture from flexiv_control rizon4s_actahead_lab.yaml

control._gains: VERIFY: joint-impedance gains are the aioflexiv README example values, not tuned for this cell

safety._source: VERIFY: flexiv_control configs/safety/actahead_lab.yaml; workspace is in the model (robot) frame
safety._max_joint_speed: VERIFY: aioflexiv move() default 1.0 rad/s times flexiv_control max_joint_speed_scale 0.30
safety._table_clearance: VERIFY: minimum distance kept between arm/gripper geometry and the table outside contact segments

primitives._note: VERIFY: travel height, standoff and retreat are placeholders carried over from the sim server

camera.name: zed
camera._real: VERIFY: ZED 2i serial, depth mode and depth units on the lab PC

sim._scene: optional MJCF scene containing the lab robot plus test objects; default is model.path
